label: ACCEPT
reason: Every Form/ModelForm subclass in the forms files is named *Form (address, pages, wishlists, basket, users); pylintrc disables C (naming) and flake8 has no naming plugin, so nothing enforces it. No outliers listed; a new misnamed form would be a worthwhile naming flag.
